context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 32 verified 3 features: (1) Cancel Order Auto Retur - PUT /api/partner-orders/{id}/status?status=cancelled returns stock to original warehouse for each item (skips external items), reduces partner debt by remaining amount. Cancelled orders show 'RETUR STOK' badge. (2) Add Items - POST /api/partner-orders/{id}/add-items with {items: [{product_id, product_name, quantity, price, source, warehouse_id, external_cost}]}. Source options: gudang_utama, gudang_toko (both deduct stock), external (no stock change, records expense in canvasser_expenses). Frontend has 'Tambah' button (data-testid='add-item-{id}') that opens dialog with product search, cart with source selector, and external_cost field when source=external. Shows margin calculation. (3) Margin Fix - GET /api/reports/partner-sales-detail uses item.subtotal or price*qty*items_per_box for dus orders, ensuring correct total_sell and no negative margins.
